scope: Handling identity: each site grip, laser and magazine selection (weapon, slot, site id) and the Attachment_* record(s) or ability progression whose selector graph scripts/frosty-attachment-handling.py reads. Identity only: every value is read from the capture on each run. Replaces the pair frosty-attachment-full-pass (research repo) plus frosty-handling-mapping-followup.json, and the research repo weapon identity file, so the generator runs from this repository alone.
method: Rows with basis 'full-pass-2026-10-13' are the research repo audit's mapped candidate comparisons (minus excludedSourceAttachments) and the follow-up rows: the identities the previous generator read. Rows with basis 'point-cost-mapping-2026-11-10' are site selections those files lack (NSW4 and the 2.1.2.0 additions); their records are the reviewed point-cost identity of the same entry. Where both exist they agree (case-insensitive) except the rows listed in disagreements.
